fanwall.unit: FWCV 40L2 = 2 x 40L1 modules, 475 kW, 130000 m3/h per end, rear return / front discharge

bulkhead.note: h3000 AS-DRAWN - slot 7.8 m2, ~2.6 m/s normal / ~5.2 m/s single-slot N-1 (~6/~24 Pa). h4000 comparison only (fails ESP in N-1).

racks.mix: 8 x HD 36 kW per side (03-10) + 2 x NET 20 kW each side of those (01-02, 11-12) = 16 HD + 8 NET = 736 kW air

hac.scheme: OPEN-TOP hot aisle (no containment roof - it sat below the pipes and blocked exhaust). Full-height end doors seal the aisle ends at rack level. Exhaust rises the full aisle length into the baffled channel and exits its open ends to the FW returns.
hac.baffles: aisle-side baffles Z 2000-3960 on Y 3200 / 5000 planes, full pod length, ENDS OPEN
hac.note: doors 60->100 outward; baffles 60->100 into the channel; outboard service-run legs removed (door swings), cross heads kept
